subject: history
concept: Understanding basic rules and why communities need them
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student role-plays a scenario with and without a simple rule, comparing outcomes
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a common rule to a picture of the problem it helps prevent
exercise.abstract: Student explains why a specific community rule exists

misconception_flags: views rules as arbitrary rather than connected to a real reason or purpose

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
